title: Gemini in Google Messages is more powerful than I initially estimated
content_html:
Published Aug 12, 2026, 8:30 AM EDT

Parth is a technology analyst and writer specializing in the comprehensive review and feature exploration of the Android ecosystem. His work focus on productivity apps and flagship devices, particularly Google Pixel and Samsung mobile hardware and software.

He provides expert guidance on productivity software, system optimization, and the advanced functionalities that allow users to maximize their device's potential. His analyses are crucial resources for readers seeking to master complex operating system features and streamline their digital workflows.

When he is not busy with technical analysis and software evaluation, Parth dedicates his time to watching K-dramas, studying mobile technology trends and the role of artificial intelligence.

Gemini in Google Messages has gone from something I barely noticed to a feature I now appreciate.

Being able to send messages through Gemini, refine awkward sentences, brainstorm without leaving a conversation, and even get caption ideas from photos makes the messaging experience feel smarter.

Together, they have made Gemini more useful inside Google Messages than I initially expected.

Gemini is already sitting inside Messages

Brainstorming without breaking my conversation flow

What I like most about Gemini in Google Messages is that I don’t have to leave the app to ask it something.

Gemini appears as its own conversation inside Messages, and I can pin it to the top so it is always within easy reach. That small detail makes a bigger difference than I expected.

Instead of opening a separate Gemini app every time I need help, I can jump into the pinned Gemini chat, ask a question, get what I need, and return to my regular conversations within seconds.

I have started using it mostly for quick brainstorming. If I am discussing a weekend plan with friends, I can ask Gemini for ideas.

If I am unsure how to respond to someone, I can ask for a few ways to phrase it (more on that in a minute).

Because this happens in Google Messages, I don’t lose the flow of what I was doing by constantly switching between apps.

There is one limitation that still bothers me, though. Gemini inside Google Messages can’t take the result and send it to one of my contacts.

Even with that limitation, I find the built-in Gemini chat useful.

Photos make Gemini much more interesting

Very handy in specific situations

Gemini became more useful to me when I started adding photos to the conversation. Text prompts are fine, but being able to attach an image gives me more to work with without leaving Google Messages.

For example, if I am about to share a vacation photo with friends, I can drop it into Gemini chat and ask for a few caption ideas.

I can ask for something funny, subtle, dramatic, or even a short one-liner, depending on the photo.

I have also found it useful when I am not sure what I am looking at or how to describe something. I can attach a photo and ask Gemini to explain it, point out notable details, or help me turn what is in the image into a better message.

That feels more natural than saving the photo, opening a separate AI app, uploading it again, and then returning to Messages.

Magic Compose understands the conversation

Add a touch of AI to those boring messages

Magic Compose is the Gemini feature in Google Messages that I use the most.

Whenever I have already typed a message but the wording does not feel quite right, I tap the + button, select Magic Compose, and let Gemini rewrite the sentence for me.

I don’t have to copy the text, jump over to Gemini, explain what I want, and paste the result into the conversation.

I can even pick from a range of styles. I can make a message sound more Chill, Excited, or Format, depending on who I am talking to.

Google also throws in playful options, such as Shakespeare and Lyrics, which I may not use every day, but they are fun when the conversation calls for something different.

There are plenty of times when I know what I want to say, but can’t get the tone right. Maybe a sentence sounds too blunt, too dry, or unnecessarily long.

Instead of rewriting it three or four times, I hand it to Magic Compose and usually get something closer to what I had in mind.

Gemini can send messages for me

A huge time saver

I can use the normal Gemini app and send a message with my voice. I can say something like, ‘Hey Gemini, tell Heema I will be home by 9 PM,’ and Gemini can prepare and send the message through Google Messages.

It is useful when my hands are occupied, or I don’t want to open Messages.

I can also take an answer Gemini has generated and ask it to send that information to someone. That is where things become much more interesting.

For example, I can ask Gemini to find my pizza recipe from Google Keep and then say, ‘Send it to Heema on Message.’

I use the same idea while traveling. I can ask Gemini to send my ETA to Jack on Messages, and it does the job without breaking a sweat.

Gemini adds serious utility to Messages

What surprised me most about Gemini in Google Messages is how naturally it fits into something I use every day. I do not need to treat it like a separate AI tool or change the way I message people.

It steps in when I need help writing something better, coming up with ideas, handling a quick message, or figuring out what to say about a photo.

Still, the integration is far from perfect. I can see plenty of room for it to become even smarter and more context-aware.

Apart from Messages, Gemini works with your WhatsApp account. Check out my dedicated post to learn more about this integration.

content_html_zh:
发布于 2026 年 8 月 12 日，美国东部时间上午 8:30

Parth 是一位技术分析师和作家，专门从事 Android 生态系统的全面回顾和功能探索。 他的工作重点是生产力应用程序和旗舰设备，特别是 Google Pixel 和三星移动硬件和软件。

他提供有关生产力软件、系统优化和高级功能的专家指导，使用户能够最大限度地发挥其设备的潜力。 他的分析对于寻求掌握复杂操作系统功能并简化数字工作流程的读者来说是至关重要的资源。

当他不忙于技术分析和软件评估时，帕斯会花时间观看韩剧、研究移动技术趋势和人工智能的作用。

Google Messages 中的 Gemini 已经从我几乎没有注意到的功能变成了我现在欣赏的功能。

能够通过 Gemini 发送消息、改进尴尬的句子、在不离开对话的情况下进行头脑风暴，甚至从照片中获取标题创意，让消息传递体验感觉更加智能。

它们共同让 Gemini 在 Google Messages 中变得比我最初预期的更加有用。

双子座已经坐在消息里了

在不破坏对话流程的情况下进行头脑风暴

我最喜欢 Google Messages 中 Gemini 的一点是，我不必离开应用程序就可以向它提问。

Gemini 在“消息”中显示为自己的对话，我可以将其固定在顶部，这样它就始终触手可及。 这个小细节产生的差异比我预期的要大。

我不必每次需要帮助时都打开单独的 Gemini 应用程序，而是可以跳入固定的 Gemini 聊天，提出问题，获取我需要的内容，然后在几秒钟内返回到我的常规对话。

我开始使用它主要是为了快速集思广益。 如果我正在和朋友讨论周末计划，我可以向双子座寻求想法。

如果我不确定如何回应某人，我可以询问一些表达方式（稍后会详细介绍）。

因为这种情况发生在 Google Messages 中，所以我不会因为不断地在应用程序之间切换而失去工作的流畅性。

不过，有一个限制仍然困扰着我。 Google Messages 中的 Gemini 无法获取结果并将其发送给我的一位联系人。

即使有这样的限制，我发现内置的 Gemini 聊天很有用。

照片让双子座变得更有趣

在特定情况下非常方便

当我开始在对话中添加照片时，双子座对我变得更加有用。 文本提示很好，但能够附加图像让我可以在不离开 Google Messages 的情况下进行更多工作。

例如，如果我要与朋友分享一张度假照片，我可以将其放入 Gemini 聊天中并询问一些标题创意。

我可以要求一些有趣的、微妙的、戏剧性的，甚至是简短的台词，具体取决于照片。

当我不确定自己在看什么或如何描述某些东西时，我还发现它很有用。 我可以附上一张照片，请双子座解释一下，指出值得注意的细节，或者帮助我将图像中的内容转化为更好的信息。

这比保存照片、打开单独的人工智能应用程序、再次上传，然后返回“消息”感觉更自然。

Magic Compose 理解对话

为那些无聊的消息添加一点人工智能

Magic Compose 是我最常使用的 Google Messages 中的 Gemini 功能。

每当我已经输入一条消息但感觉措辞不太正确时，我都会点击+按钮，选择“Magic Compose”，然后让 Gemini 为我重写句子。

我不必复制文本，跳到 Gemini，解释我想要什么，然后将结果粘贴到对话中。

我什至可以从多种风格中进行选择。 我可以让一条消息听起来更冷静、更兴奋或更有格式，具体取决于我的谈话对象。

谷歌还提供了一些有趣的选项，例如莎士比亚和歌词，我可能不会每天使用它们，但当对话需要不同的东西时，它们很有趣。

很多时候我知道自己想说什么，但语气不正确。 也许一个句子听起来太生硬、太枯燥或不必要地长。

我不会重写三四次，而是将其交给 Magic Compose，通常会得到更接近我想法的内容。

双子座可以帮我发消息

节省大量时间

我可以使用普通的 Gemini 应用程序并用语音发送消息。 我可以说“嘿 Gemini，告诉 Heema 我晚上 9 点到家”，然后 Gemini 就可以通过 Google Messages 准备并发送消息。

当我的手很忙或者不想打开“消息”时，它很有用。

我还可以获取 Gemini 生成的答案，并要求它将该信息发送给某人。 这就是事情变得更加有趣的地方。

例如，我可以要求 Gemini 从 Google Keep 中找到我的披萨食谱，然后说“通过消息将其发送给 Heema”。

我在旅行时也用同样的想法。 我可以要求 Gemini 通过消息将我的预计到达时间发送给 Jack，它毫不费力就能完成这项工作。

Gemini 为消息添加了重要的实用性

Google Messages 中的 Gemini 最让我惊讶的是它能如此自然地融入我每天使用的东西中。 我不需要将其视为单独的人工智能工具或改变我向人们发送消息的方式。

当我需要帮助写出更好的东西、提出想法、处理一条快速消息或弄清楚该对照片说些什么时，它就会介入。

尽管如此，整合还远未达到完美。 我认为它还有很大的空间可以变得更加智能、更加具有情境感知能力。

除了消息之外，Gemini 还可以使用您的 WhatsApp 帐户。 查看我的专门帖子以了解有关此集成的更多信息。
